# Electric Dirt Bike Australia

> Australian online dealer of electric dirt bikes, electric motorbikes, e-bikes, kids electric bikes, lithium battery packs and chargers (Sur-Ron, Talaria, Stark Varg, KTM SX-E, E-Ride Pro, RTR eBike and more), dispatched from Mittagong NSW with a 12-month Australian warranty.
